messages:
maria: Morning — scheduling a cross-region eviction rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 PT. Objective: validate mixed-capacity fallback (spot -> reserved -> on-demand), KV cache warmup, and autoscaler behavior under repeated AZ preemptions. Estimate 45m. TL;DR: we will force-evict 20% of GPU tasks in us-west2, then scale to us-east1. Can everyone join?

sam: I can do the runbook and watch scaling metrics. Will wire up P99 latency alerts to slack.

alejandra: I’ll prepare routing policies and make sure canary traffic is pinned to dedicated pool. Also will pause any rolling deploys.

kevin: I will have a small prompt set and eval harness ready to detect quality regressions, plus embeddings cache checks.

maria: Runbook snippet — devs will run:
```bash
# evict 20% nodes in us-west2
python tools/evict_sim.py --region us-west2 --percent 20 --force
# failover test: disable spot pool for 5m
gcloud compute instances update --no-spot --zone us-west2-a --all
```
Please don't run in prod projects other than sandbox.

sam: Can we test two modes: (1) progressive evictions over 10m, (2) blast eviction in 30s? Need both.

alejandra: Agree. For progressive we'll set drain-grace=60s. For blast we'll use drain-grace=5s.

maria: Success criteria (quick):
- autoscaler triggers additional reserved capacity < 2m
- API 95th latency < 250ms for 95% of requests, P99 < 1.2s
- No data-plane errors > 0.1% for > 5m
- Model-serving cache hit rate stays > 85%
- Rollback/route fallback completed without manual intervention

kevin: Add quality guard: top-3 generation BLEU/ROUGE deltas within 2% vs baseline. If >=2% we abort.

sam: Paging: plan to set PagerDuty to maintenance for the rehearsal. PD schedule: infra-oncall -> eng-sre -> fallback. Sam will create maintenance mode at start.

maria: Preflight checklist:
- [x] Runbook in docs: /runbooks/eviction-rehearsal
- [x] Canary pinned: yes
- [ ] Load generator configured (kevin)
- [ ] Dashboard with p95/p99 added (sam)
- [ ] Eviction simulation bot permissions validated (ops-bot)
- [ ] PD maintenance window set (sam)

kevin: Load generator ready. Will ramp to 2x typical token QPS for 10m window. Will push prompt set to eval job.

alejandra: Ops note: We will tag any new instances with pool=reserved so smart-router can prefer them. Also will set cache priming lambda to run on new nodes.

maria: During run, use the channel #eng-platform-live for all callouts. Tag me @maria and @sam for escalations. Post exact time outputs.

evict-bot: simulated-eviction START region=us-west2 percent=20 mode=progressive user=maria
evict-bot: node_count_before=120 node_count_after=96 nodes_drained=24 time_elapsed=180
evict-bot: autoscaler_action=start_add_capacity type=reserved target=30 time=45s
evict-bot: cache_hit_rate=88% avg_p95_latency=220ms p99=980ms

sam: Observed autoscaler spike at 46s, added 28 reserved GPUs. No 500s in API. p99 briefly hit 1.1s for 30s window.

kevin: Eval job results: rouge-diff=+0.3% bleu-diff=-0.8% — within guardrails.

alejandra: Router failover: 92% traffic moved to reserved pool automatically, 8% retried and hit on-demand. All good.

maria: Postmortem notes: two action items:
1) tighten autoscaler threshold to trigger at 40s for mixed pools (owner: sam)
2) add synthetic traffic to warm KV cache on new nodes (owner: kevin)

sam: Also recommend we add an "az-blast" scenario to test a single AZ outage.

maria: Great work. Rehearsal concluded — marking thread resolved. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
